name: Human Tyerkow Expert 5 (CR 4)
body:
TYERKOW
CR 4

A gaunt figure with pallid sinew stretched taut over exposed bone. Its body lacks skin entirely, revealing tendons and raw musculature. Lidless unblinking eyes stare with intensity.

XP 1,200
Human tyerkow expert 5
NE Medium undead (augmented humanoid, human)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +19

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 42 (5d8+20); regeneration 10 (positive energy, running water, or sunlight)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +7
Defensive Abilities tyerkow skin; channel resistance +4; Immune cold, undead traits
Weaknesses tyerkow weaknesses

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +8 (1d4+5) and bite +8 (1d6+5) or mwk heavy mace +9 (1d8+5), slam +3 (1d4+2), and bite +3 (1d6+2)
Ranged mwk sling +6 (1d4+5)
Special Attacks blood drain (1d4 Con), blood hypnosis (DC 14), nightchill strike +3d6, soporific gaze (DC 14), summon vermin

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 15, Con —, Int 9, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +8; CMD 21
Feats Alertness B, Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative B, Iron Will, Power Attack, Toughness B
Skills Bluff +18, Diplomacy +8, Disguise +18, Perception +19, Profession (any one) +9, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +18; Racial Modifiers +8 Bluff, +8 Disguise, +8 Perception, +8 Stealth
Languages Common

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure NPC Gear (potion of invisibility, potion of spider climb, mwk heavy mace, mwk sling with 10 sling stones, boots of the cat, other treasure)

A terrifying nocturnal predator from African folklore, the tyerkow is a vampire-like creature with a dual existence. By day, it wears its humanoid skin, blending seamlessly into city life, posing as a neighbor, passerby, or vendor. Unlike other vampires, the tyerkow can walk unscathed in sunlight as long as it wears this skin, peeling it off each night to reveal its true form. Once unskinned, the tyerkow becomes a formidable predator, possessing rapid regeneration and resistance to non-magical weapons. Its presence carries a faint chill, as if the air itself recoils from its touch. The tyerkow stalks prey with haunting patience, lulling victims into sleep or subduing them with a gaze that fascinates, drinking blood while they sleep. Tyerkow can summon swarms of rats or cockroaches, filthy, disease-ridden extensions of its hunger.

Despite the benefits of being skinless, a tyerkow is still vulnerable. Sunlight burns it to ash if caught without its skin.

If the tyerkow’s skin is destroyed, then this undead horror disintegrates at the next dawn. Although tyerkows can walk in daylight while wearing their skin, they still favor the cover of night and often slumber during the day. These solitary beings carefully guard their hidden skins, as discovery means their doom. These creatures conceal themselves in secret sanctuaries, urban lairs tucked away from prying eyes and the deadly kiss of sunlight. Use the tyerkow Resting Places table to choose or inspire the hidden refuge where one of these undead horrors waits out the day.

Tyerkow Resting Places
d6	Resting Place
1	Soot-blackened attic above a bakery, nestled among burlap sacks and scorched bread racks. The scent of yeast masks the odor of dried blood.
2	Hidden crawlspace beneath a butcher’s shop, sealed behind rusted meat hooks and slabs of spoiled meat. The tyerkow’s flayed skin is stretched over a mannequin.
3	Walled-up alcove in an abandoned tenement, behind layers of graffiti and crumbling plaster. Cockroaches scurry over bundles of discarded clothing and bones.
4	Sewage runoff pipe in the city’s drainage tunnels, sealed with an iron grate marked with symbols of warding. The tyerkow’s skin is stored in an oilskin pouch hung from the ceiling.
5	Inside a repurposed shipping container stacked among others at a rusting freight yard, guarded by swarms of rats and the distant hum of dock machinery.
6	A forgotten tomb in the city’s oldest cemetery, now hidden beneath a collapsing mausoleum wall. Urban development has swallowed the graveyard whole, leaving it trapped in concrete shadow.
